aviation.en: Modern aviation connects distant cities and supports international travel and trade.
aviation.zh: 現代航空連結遙遠城市，也支援國際旅行與貿易。

await.en: Students await the final results after completing the science competition.
await.zh: 學生完成科學競賽後等待最終結果。

awaken.en: Bright morning sunlight can awaken people before their alarm rings.
awaken.zh: 明亮的晨光可能在鬧鐘響前喚醒人們。

awe.en: The enormous night sky filled the young observers with awe.
awe.zh: 廣大的夜空讓年輕觀察者充滿敬畏。

awhile.en: We rested awhile before continuing our walk along the coast.
awhile.zh: 我們休息了一會兒，再繼續沿著海岸散步。

awkward.en: The first conversation felt awkward, but everyone soon became comfortable.
awkward.zh: 第一次交談有些尷尬，但大家很快就自在起來。

bachelor.en: He earned a bachelor degree before applying to graduate school.
bachelor.zh: 他取得學士學位後才申請研究所。

backbone.en: Trust is the backbone of effective teamwork in difficult projects.
backbone.zh: 信任是困難專案中有效團隊合作的支柱。

backpack.en: She packed a notebook and water bottle in her backpack.
backpack.zh: 她把筆記本和水瓶放進背包。

backwards.en: He stepped backwards carefully to avoid touching the wet paint.
backwards.zh: 他小心往後退，以免碰到未乾的油漆。

backyard.en: The family planted several herbs in their small backyard garden.
backyard.zh: 這家人在小小的後院花園種了幾種香草。

bacon.en: The cafe offers eggs, toast, and bacon as a breakfast set.
bacon.zh: 這間咖啡店提供雞蛋、吐司和培根的早餐套餐。

badge.en: Each volunteer wore a badge showing their name and role.
badge.zh: 每位志工都佩戴寫有姓名和職務的識別證。

badminton.en: Our class plays badminton in the gym every Friday afternoon.
badminton.zh: 我們班每週五下午都在體育館打羽球。

baggage.en: Passengers should keep important documents outside their checked baggage.
baggage.zh: 旅客應把重要文件放在托運行李之外。

bait.en: The fisherman placed bait on the hook before casting the line.
bait.zh: 漁夫在拋出釣線前先把餌裝上魚鉤。

bravery.en: Her bravery helped the group remain calm during the emergency drill.
bravery.zh: 她的勇氣幫助小組在緊急演練中保持冷靜。

breadth.en: The course offers impressive breadth across science, history, and literature.
breadth.zh: 這門課在科學、歷史和文學方面涵蓋範圍很廣。

breakdown.en: The mechanic explained the breakdown in simple terms to the driver.
breakdown.zh: 技師用簡單的方式向駕駛解釋故障原因。

breakthrough.en: The research team announced a breakthrough after years of careful testing.
breakthrough.zh: 研究團隊在多年仔細測試後宣布一項突破。

breakup.en: The breakup of the large ice sheet changed the coastline nearby.
breakup.zh: 大型冰層的碎裂改變了附近的海岸線。

breed.en: Farmers breed certain plants for stronger resistance to dry weather.
breed.zh: 農民培育某些植物，使它們更能抵抗乾旱天氣。

breeze.en: A cool breeze entered the classroom through the open windows.
breeze.zh: 一陣涼風吹進開著窗戶的教室。

brick.en: The old library was built with dark red brick walls.
brick.zh: 舊圖書館是用深紅色磚牆建成的。

bride.en: The bride thanked the guests for joining the family celebration.
bride.zh: 新娘感謝賓客參加這場家庭慶祝活動。

bridegroom.en: The bridegroom greeted relatives before the wedding ceremony began.
bridegroom.zh: 新郎在婚禮儀式開始前向親友打招呼。

briefcase.en: The lawyer placed the documents carefully inside a black briefcase.
briefcase.zh: 律師把文件小心放進黑色公事包。

bright.en: The bright classroom made it easier for students to read.
bright.zh: 明亮的教室讓學生更容易閱讀。

brilliant.en: Her brilliant solution saved the team hours of extra work.
brilliant.zh: 她出色的解決方法替團隊省下好幾小時的額外工作。

brink.en: The company recovered from the brink of serious financial trouble.
brink.zh: 這家公司從嚴重財務困境的邊緣恢復過來。

brochure.en: The museum brochure includes a map and opening hours for visitors.
brochure.zh: 博物館手冊包含地圖和供訪客參考的開放時間。

broil.en: The recipe says to broil the vegetables briefly before serving.
broil.zh: 食譜寫著上桌前要短時間烤一下蔬菜。

broke.en: The old chair broke when too much weight was placed on it.
broke.zh: 舊椅子因承受過多重量而壞掉了。

bronze.en: The athlete received a bronze medal after finishing third overall.
bronze.zh: 這名運動員總排名第三，因此獲得銅牌。

brook.en: A narrow brook runs behind the village during the rainy season.
brook.zh: 雨季時，一條狹窄小溪流過村莊後方。

broom.en: The cleaner used a broom to sweep leaves from the entrance.
broom.zh: 清潔人員用掃把把入口處的落葉掃掉。

broth.en: The soup uses vegetable broth as its main liquid base.
broth.zh: 這道湯以蔬菜高湯作為主要湯底。

brotherhood.en: The club promotes friendship, service, and brotherhood among its members.
brotherhood.zh: 這個社團在成員之間提倡友誼、服務與手足情誼。

brow.en: He wiped the sweat from his brow after the long hike.
brow.zh: 長途健行後，他擦去額頭上的汗。

browse.en: Students can browse the digital catalog before choosing a library book.
browse.zh: 學生可以先瀏覽數位目錄，再選擇圖書館的書。

bruise.en: A small bruise appeared after she bumped into the desk.
bruise.zh: 她撞到桌子後出現一小塊瘀青。

brunch.en: We met for brunch after finishing the morning volunteer activity.
brunch.zh: 完成早上的志工活動後，我們一起吃早午餐。

brutal.en: The documentary described the brutal winter conditions faced by early explorers.
brutal.zh: 這部紀錄片描述早期探險家面對的嚴酷冬季環境。

bubble.en: A bubble formed on the surface as the water heated.
bubble.zh: 水加熱時，表面形成了一個氣泡。

bucket.en: They filled a bucket with water for cleaning the classroom floor.
bucket.zh: 他們裝了一桶水來清潔教室地板。

bud.en: A small flower bud appeared on the plant in early spring.
bud.zh: 初春時，植物上長出一個小花苞。

budget.en: The student council created a budget for the school festival.
budget.zh: 學生會為校慶活動編列了一份預算。

buffalo.en: The wildlife center teaches visitors how buffalo live in grasslands.
buffalo.zh: 野生動物中心教導訪客水牛如何生活在草原。

buffet.en: The hotel serves a breakfast buffet with many different choices.
buffet.zh: 這間飯店提供有多種選擇的自助式早餐。

bug.en: The programmer fixed a bug that caused the page to freeze.
bug.zh: 程式設計師修正了一個造成網頁卡住的程式錯誤。

bulb.en: We replaced the broken light bulb before the presentation started.
bulb.zh: 我們在簡報開始前更換了壞掉的燈泡。

bulk.en: The bulk of the report focuses on environmental changes over time.
bulk.zh: 這份報告的大部分內容聚焦於長期環境變化。

bulky.en: The bulky package was difficult to carry through the narrow doorway.
bulky.zh: 這個笨重包裹很難搬過狹窄的門口。

bull.en: The farm keeps one bull in a separate fenced field.
bull.zh: 農場把一頭公牛養在獨立的圍欄牧場裡。

bulletin.en: The school bulletin lists upcoming events and important reminders for students.
bulletin.zh: 學校公告列出即將到來的活動和重要提醒。

bully.en: Teachers should respond quickly when a bully targets another student.
bully.zh: 當霸凌者針對其他學生時，老師應迅速處理。

bump.en: There is a small bump in the road near the gate.
bump.zh: 大門附近的道路上有一個小凸起。

bun.en: The bakery sells a soft bun filled with sweet red beans.
bun.zh: 這間麵包店販售包著甜紅豆餡的軟麵包。

bunch.en: She placed a bunch of fresh flowers beside the window.
bunch.zh: 她把一束鮮花放在窗邊。

bundle.en: The store offers a bundle of notebooks at a lower price.
bundle.zh: 這家店以較低價格販售一組筆記本。

bureau.en: The tourism bureau publishes maps and travel information for visitors.
bureau.zh: 觀光局出版地圖與旅遊資訊供訪客使用。

bureaucracy.en: Too much bureaucracy can slow the approval of simple projects.
bureaucracy.zh: 過多官僚程序可能拖慢簡單專案的核准。

bureaucrat.en: The article described how one bureaucrat helped simplify the application process.
bureaucrat.zh: 文章描述一名官員如何協助簡化申請流程。

burger.en: The restaurant added a vegetable burger to its lunch menu.
burger.zh: 這間餐廳在午餐菜單新增了蔬菜漢堡。

burglar.en: The security system can alert residents when a burglar enters.
burglar.zh: 當竊賊闖入時，保全系統可以提醒住戶。

burial.en: The museum exhibit explains ancient burial customs through artifacts and drawings.
burial.zh: 博物館展覽透過文物和圖畫介紹古代埋葬習俗。

burst.en: A water pipe may burst if pressure becomes too high.
burst.zh: 如果壓力過高，水管可能會爆裂。

bury.en: Gardeners bury seeds beneath a thin layer of soil.
bury.zh: 園丁把種子埋在薄薄一層土壤下。

bush.en: A small bird built its nest inside the thick bush.
bush.zh: 一隻小鳥把巢築在茂密的灌木裡。

businessman.en: The businessman invested in a company that develops clean energy technology.
businessman.zh: 這名商人投資一家開發潔淨能源技術的公司。

butcher.en: The butcher prepared the order before the market opened.
butcher.zh: 肉販在市場開門前準備好訂單。

butter.en: She spread a little butter on the warm toast.
butter.zh: 她在溫熱吐司上抹了一點奶油。

butterfly.en: A colorful butterfly landed on a flower beside the trail.
butterfly.zh: 一隻色彩鮮豔的蝴蝶停在步道旁的花上。

buzz.en: We heard the buzz of insects near the garden pond.
buzz.zh: 我們在花園池塘附近聽見昆蟲嗡嗡聲。

bypass.en: The new road will bypass the crowded town center during rush hour.
bypass.zh: 新道路會在尖峰時段繞過擁擠的市中心。

cab.en: They took a cab from the station to the hotel.
cab.zh: 他們從車站搭計程車到飯店。

cabin.en: The hikers stayed in a small cabin near the forest.
cabin.zh: 健行者住在森林附近的一間小木屋。

cabinet.en: The teacher stored art supplies inside the locked cabinet.
cabinet.zh: 老師把美術用品放在上鎖的櫃子裡。

cable.en: Check that the cable is connected firmly before starting the computer.
cable.zh: 啟動電腦前，請確認電線已牢固連接。

cafe.en: The small cafe near campus is quiet in the morning.
cafe.zh: 校園附近的小咖啡店早上很安靜。

cafeteria.en: Students gathered in the cafeteria during the lunch break.
cafeteria.zh: 午休時，學生聚集在自助餐廳。

caffeine.en: The health lesson explained how caffeine can affect sleep patterns.
caffeine.zh: 健康課說明咖啡因可能如何影響睡眠模式。

calcium.en: The science textbook explains why calcium is important for bones.
calcium.zh: 科學課本說明鈣為什麼對骨骼很重要。

calculation.en: Please check your calculation before writing the final answer.
calculation.zh: 寫下最後答案前，請先檢查你的計算。

calculator.en: Students may use a calculator for this part of the test.
calculator.zh: 學生可以在這部分測驗使用計算機。

calligraphy.en: The art club practices Chinese calligraphy every Wednesday after school.
calligraphy.zh: 美術社每週三放學後練習中文書法。

calorie.en: The nutrition label shows the calorie value of each serving.
calorie.zh: 營養標示顯示每份食物的熱量數值。

camel.en: A camel can travel long distances across dry desert areas.
camel.zh: 駱駝可以在乾燥沙漠地區長途行走。

canal.en: The historic canal once carried goods between the two towns.
canal.zh: 這條歷史運河過去曾在兩座城鎮間運送貨物。

candle.en: A single candle provided soft light during the power outage.
candle.zh: 停電期間，一根蠟燭提供了柔和光線。

cane.en: The elderly visitor used a cane while walking through the museum.
cane.zh: 年長訪客參觀博物館時使用手杖行走。

clause.en: The teacher asked us to identify the main clause in each sentence.
clause.zh: 老師要我們找出每個句子中的主要子句。

claw.en: The bird used its claw to hold the branch firmly.
claw.zh: 這隻鳥用爪子牢牢抓住樹枝。

clay.en: Students shaped the soft clay into small bowls during art class.
clay.zh: 學生在美術課把柔軟黏土捏成小碗。

cleaner.en: The cleaner finished the hallway before students arrived in the morning.
cleaner.zh: 清潔人員在學生早上到校前清理完走廊。

clearance.en: The truck needs enough clearance to pass safely under the bridge.
clearance.zh: 卡車需要足夠淨空高度才能安全通過橋下。

cliff.en: The trail ends near a steep cliff overlooking the sea.
cliff.zh: 步道終點靠近一處俯瞰海面的陡峭懸崖。

climax.en: The story reaches its climax when the mystery is finally solved.
climax.zh: 故事在謎團終於解開時達到高潮。

cling.en: Wet leaves often cling to shoes after heavy rain.
cling.zh: 大雨過後，濕葉子常會黏在鞋子上。

clinic.en: The school clinic provides basic care for students who feel unwell.
clinic.zh: 學校保健室為身體不適的學生提供基本照護。

clinical.en: The article summarizes clinical research in clear language for general readers.
clinical.zh: 這篇文章用清楚語言為一般讀者摘要臨床研究。

clip.en: The teacher showed a short video clip before the discussion.
clip.zh: 老師在討論前播放了一段短影片。

clockwise.en: Turn the dial clockwise until the arrow reaches the marked line.
clockwise.zh: 順時針轉動旋鈕，直到箭頭到達標記線。

clone.en: Scientists can study a clone to understand how genes influence traits.
clone.zh: 科學家可以研究複製個體，以了解基因如何影響特徵。

closet.en: The extra chairs are stored in the closet beside the classroom.
closet.zh: 多出的椅子存放在教室旁的儲藏櫃裡。

closure.en: The road closure forced buses to use a different route.
closure.zh: 道路封閉迫使公車改走其他路線。

clothe.en: Charity groups help clothe families who need basic winter supplies.
clothe.zh: 慈善團體協助有需要的家庭取得基本冬季衣物。

clothing.en: Warm clothing is essential when hiking in cold mountain weather.
clothing.zh: 在寒冷山區健行時，保暖衣物非常重要。

cloudy.en: The sky remained cloudy throughout most of the afternoon.
cloudy.zh: 下午大部分時間天空都維持多雲。

clown.en: The clown entertained children with simple jokes and colorful balloons.
clown.zh: 小丑用簡單笑話和彩色氣球逗孩子開心。

clue.en: One small clue helped the students solve the classroom puzzle.
clue.zh: 一個小線索幫助學生解開教室謎題。

clumsy.en: His clumsy attempt knocked several papers off the desk.
clumsy.zh: 他笨拙的動作把幾張紙碰落桌面。

cluster.en: A cluster of stars became visible after the clouds cleared.
cluster.zh: 雲散開後，一群星星變得清晰可見。

coarse.en: The fabric feels coarse compared with the softer sample.
coarse.zh: 和較柔軟的樣本相比，這塊布摸起來較粗糙。

coastline.en: The map shows how the coastline changed after several major storms.
coastline.zh: 地圖顯示幾場大風暴後海岸線如何改變。

cockroach.en: A cockroach can survive in many warm and sheltered environments.
cockroach.zh: 蟑螂可以在許多溫暖且有遮蔽的環境中生存。

cocoa.en: The recipe uses cocoa to give the cake a rich flavor.
cocoa.zh: 這份食譜用可可粉讓蛋糕具有濃郁風味。

coconut.en: The dessert combines coconut with rice and fresh fruit.
coconut.zh: 這道甜點把椰子、米和新鮮水果搭配在一起。

cognitive.en: Regular sleep supports cognitive functions such as memory and attention.
cognitive.zh: 規律睡眠有助於記憶與注意力等認知功能。

coincidence.en: It was a coincidence that both teams chose the same topic.
coincidence.zh: 兩組都選到相同主題只是巧合。

cola.en: The survey compared water, juice, and cola preferences among students.
cola.zh: 這份調查比較學生對水、果汁和可樂的偏好。

collaboration.en: Successful collaboration requires clear goals and regular communication among team members.
collaboration.zh: 成功合作需要明確目標與團隊成員之間的定期溝通。

collar.en: The dog wore a blue collar with an identification tag.
collar.zh: 那隻狗戴著有識別牌的藍色項圈。

colleague.en: The researcher asked a colleague to review the draft report.
colleague.zh: 研究人員請一位同事審閱報告草稿。

collector.en: The museum collector carefully recorded where each object came from.
collector.zh: 博物館收藏家仔細記錄每件物品的來源。

collision.en: The simulation shows how speed affects the force of a collision.
collision.zh: 模擬顯示速度如何影響碰撞力量。

colloquial.en: This expression is common in colloquial English but rare in formal writing.
colloquial.zh: 這個表達在口語英文很常見，但正式寫作較少使用。

colonial.en: The museum displays maps from the region's colonial period.
colonial.zh: 博物館展示這個地區殖民時期的地圖。

colony.en: A large penguin colony gathers near the coast each year.
colony.zh: 每年都有大型企鵝群聚集在海岸附近。

colorful.en: The colorful poster attracted attention from students across the hallway.
colorful.zh: 色彩鮮豔的海報吸引走廊上學生的注意。

columnist.en: The newspaper columnist writes weekly about education and technology trends.
columnist.zh: 這位報紙專欄作家每週撰寫教育與科技趨勢。

comb.en: She used a comb to tidy her hair before the performance.
comb.zh: 她在表演前用梳子整理頭髮。

combination.en: A combination of practice and feedback improved the team's performance.
combination.zh: 練習與回饋的結合提升了團隊表現。

comedian.en: The comedian used everyday school experiences as material for gentle jokes.
comedian.zh: 這位喜劇演員用日常校園經驗作為輕鬆笑話的素材。

comedy.en: The class watched a short comedy before discussing different film genres.
comedy.zh: 全班看了一部短喜劇，再討論不同電影類型。

comet.en: Astronomers tracked the comet as it moved across the night sky.
comet.zh: 天文學家追蹤彗星穿越夜空的移動。

comic.en: The library keeps a comic section for students who enjoy illustrated stories.
comic.zh: 圖書館設有漫畫區，提供給喜歡圖像故事的學生。

comma.en: Place a comma after the opening phrase in this sentence.
comma.zh: 請在這個句子的開頭片語後加上逗號。

commentary.en: The documentary includes expert commentary that explains the historical background.
commentary.zh: 這部紀錄片包含專家評論，用來說明歷史背景。

commentator.en: The sports commentator explained the strategy clearly during the match.
commentator.zh: 體育評論員在比賽中清楚解釋戰術。

commission.en: The city commission reviewed the proposal before approving new park facilities.
commission.zh: 市府委員會在核准新公園設施前審查了提案。

commitment.en: Learning a language requires patience, practice, and long-term commitment.
commitment.zh: 學習語言需要耐心、練習與長期投入。

commonplace.en: Online meetings have become commonplace in many international organizations.
commonplace.zh: 線上會議已在許多國際組織中變得很普遍。

communicative.en: The course uses communicative activities to help students practice speaking naturally.
communicative.zh: 這門課使用溝通式活動幫助學生自然練習口說。

commute.en: Many workers commute by train because parking is limited downtown.
commute.zh: 許多上班族搭火車通勤，因為市中心停車位有限。

commuter.en: Each commuter can check train delays through the transit app.
commuter.zh: 每位通勤者都能透過交通應用程式查看列車延誤。

compact.en: The compact camera fits easily inside a small travel bag.
compact.zh: 這台小型相機很容易放進小旅行袋。

companion.en: The guide served as a helpful companion during the museum visit.
companion.zh: 導覽員在博物館參觀期間成為很有幫助的陪伴者。

comparable.en: The two studies produced comparable results despite using different samples.
comparable.zh: 儘管使用不同樣本，兩項研究仍得到可比較的結果。

comparative.en: The report provides a comparative analysis of three learning methods.
comparative.zh: 這份報告提供三種學習方法的比較分析。

compass.en: The hikers used a compass to confirm the correct direction.
compass.zh: 健行者用指南針確認正確方向。

compassion.en: The volunteer showed compassion toward families facing difficult circumstances.
compassion.zh: 這名志工對面臨困難處境的家庭展現同理與關懷。

compassionate.en: A compassionate response can make a worried student feel supported.
compassionate.zh: 有同理心的回應能讓焦慮的學生感到被支持。

compel.en: Strong evidence may compel researchers to reconsider their original explanation.
compel.zh: 有力證據可能迫使研究人員重新考慮原本的解釋。

compensation.en: The company offered compensation for the delay caused by the system error.
compensation.zh: 公司針對系統錯誤造成的延誤提供補償。

competence.en: The practical test measures competence in several basic laboratory skills.
competence.zh: 實作測驗衡量幾項基本實驗技能的熟練程度。

competitor.en: Each competitor had ten minutes to present a solution to the judges.
competitor.zh: 每位參賽者有十分鐘向評審提出解決方案。

complaint.en: The office recorded each complaint and replied within two working days.
complaint.zh: 辦公室記錄每項申訴，並在兩個工作天內回覆。

complexion.en: The portrait artist used warm tones to match the subject's complexion.
complexion.zh: 肖像畫家使用暖色調來配合人物的膚色。

complexity.en: The diagram reduces the complexity of the process into five clear steps.
complexity.zh: 這張圖把複雜流程簡化成五個清楚步驟。

compliance.en: Regular inspections help ensure compliance with laboratory safety rules.
compliance.zh: 定期檢查有助於確保遵守實驗室安全規定。

complication.en: A scheduling complication forced the team to move the meeting online.
complication.zh: 一項時程上的複雜狀況迫使團隊改為線上開會。

compliment.en: The teacher gave the group a compliment for its clear presentation.
compliment.zh: 老師稱讚這組的簡報很清楚。

comply.en: All participants must comply with the rules listed on the form.
comply.zh: 所有參與者都必須遵守表格上列出的規定。

composer.en: The composer created music for several student theater productions.
composer.zh: 這位作曲家為幾齣學生戲劇製作創作音樂。

compound.en: Water is a compound made from hydrogen and oxygen atoms.
compound.zh: 水是由氫原子和氧原子組成的化合物。

comprehend.en: Students often comprehend difficult ideas better after seeing a clear example.
comprehend.zh: 學生看過清楚例子後，通常更能理解困難概念。

comprehension.en: Regular reading practice can improve vocabulary and comprehension over time.
comprehension.zh: 規律閱讀練習可以逐漸提升字彙與理解能力。

comprise.en: The final assessment will comprise a written test and short presentation.
comprise.zh: 期末評量將包含筆試和短篇簡報。

compromise.en: The two groups reached a compromise after discussing their different priorities.
compromise.zh: 兩組討論不同優先事項後達成妥協。

compulsory.en: Safety training is compulsory before students may enter the laboratory.
compulsory.zh: 學生進入實驗室前，安全訓練是強制必修的。

compute.en: The program can compute the average score in less than a second.
compute.zh: 這個程式能在不到一秒內計算平均分數。

computerize.en: The library plans to computerize its old paper borrowing records.
computerize.zh: 圖書館計畫把舊的紙本借閱紀錄電腦化。

conception.en: The exhibition challenges the common conception of what a classroom should be.
conception.zh: 這場展覽挑戰人們對教室應該是什麼樣子的普遍觀念。

concerning.en: The school sent parents an update concerning the new schedule.
concerning.zh: 學校寄給家長一份關於新時程的最新通知。

concession.en: The organizers made one concession by extending the submission deadline.
concession.zh: 主辦單位做出一項讓步，延長了繳交期限。

concise.en: A concise summary should include the main idea without unnecessary detail.
concise.zh: 簡潔摘要應包含主旨，不加入不必要細節。

condemn.en: The school will condemn bullying and support students who report it.
condemn.zh: 學校會譴責霸凌，並支持提出通報的學生。

condense.en: Please condense the long paragraph into three clear sentences.
condense.zh: 請把這段長文濃縮成三個清楚句子。

conductor.en: The conductor guided the orchestra through the final rehearsal smoothly.
conductor.zh: 指揮順利帶領樂團完成最後一次彩排。

cone.en: The geometry lesson explains how to calculate the volume of a cone.
cone.zh: 幾何課說明如何計算圓錐體積。

confess.en: He decided to confess that he had copied the wrong data.
confess.zh: 他決定坦承自己抄錯了資料。

confession.en: Her confession helped the group understand how the mistake happened.
confession.zh: 她的坦承幫助小組了解錯誤是如何發生的。

confront.en: Students must confront difficult questions instead of ignoring them completely.
confront.zh: 學生必須面對困難問題，而不是完全忽略它們。

confrontation.en: A calm discussion prevented the disagreement from becoming a confrontation.
confrontation.zh: 冷靜討論避免意見不合演變成正面衝突。

confusion.en: Clear labels can reduce confusion when several samples look similar.
confusion.zh: 當多個樣本看起來相似時，清楚標籤可以減少混淆。

congratulate.en: Teachers gathered to congratulate the students on their successful project.
congratulate.zh: 老師們聚在一起祝賀學生專題成功。

congratulation.en: The card included a warm congratulation for the graduating class.
congratulation.zh: 卡片中寫著對畢業班溫暖的祝賀。
